name: pwr_currentconsumption_standby
description: PWR_CurrentConsumption in Standby mode (STANDBY_MODE, the readme's fourth line). After B1 (held from 0.5 to 1.2 s) the backup domain is reset, WUF cleared, the WKUP1 pin enabled (PWR_CSR 0x100: PA0 an input with a pull-down) and the part enters Standby: the pins let go, LD2 goes dark. SW1 joins PA0 to 3V3 at 2.0 s, as the readme's wire does: its rising edge sets WUF and ends Standby, the part resets (RCC_CSR's flags as at power-on, PORRSTF, PINRSTF and BORRSTF), main finds SBF set, clears it and toggles LD2 every 100 ms; PWR_CSR keeps WUF and EWUP through the reset (0x34101 with the regulator's ready bits).
